function one({flag = true}) { const b: boolean = flag; console.log(b); }
one({});
one({flag: 1});
function two([key = 'x']) { const b: string = key; console.log(b); }
two([]);
two(['y']);
two([1]);
two(['y','extra']);
function mixed([first = 1, second]: any) { console.log(first, second); }
function missing({a = 1, missing}) { let n: number = a; console.log(n, missing); }
function nestedOuter({ nested: { member } = { member: 1 } }) {const check: number = member;}
function nestedMissing({ nested: { member } = {} }) {console.log(member);}
function nestedInner({ nested: { member = 1 } }) {const check: number = member;}
nestedInner({nested:{}});
nestedInner({});
function rest([a=1, ...rest]) { console.log(a, rest); }
function objectRest({a=1, ...rest}) { console.log(a, rest); }
function annotatedAny({a = 1}: any) {const control: string = a; }
function optionalTuple([a=1, b]) { console.log(a,b); }
function capture({x = undefined}) { const impossible: number = x; }
function nestedDefault({nested: {member} = {member:1}}) { const invalid: string = member; }
function siblingCycle({
  a = 1,
  b = a
}) { console.log(a, b); }
function directCycle({x = x}) { console.log(x); }

function exact({x:{a=1}={extra:2}}) {console.log(a);}
function typed({x:{a=1}={a:'wrong'}}) {const invalid:number=a;}
function missingObject({x:{a}={}}) {console.log(a);}
function missingTuple({x:[a]=[]}) {console.log(a);}
const nestedKey = 'a';
function computedKey({x:{[nestedKey]: value=1}={}}){const y:number=value;console.log(y);}
computedKey({x:{a:'wrong'}});
computedKey({x:{notPresent:2}});
function explicitTuple({x:{value:[n=1]}={value:[]}}) { console.log(n); }
explicitTuple({x:{value:[2]}});
function explicitArrayElement({x:[[n=2]]=[[]]}) { console.log(n); }
explicitArrayElement({x:[[3]]});
function directTupleDefault({x:[n=1,m=2]=[3]}) { console.log(n, m); }
directTupleDefault({x:[]});
function optionalProperty({x:{value:[n=1]=[]}={value:[]}}) { console.log(n); }
optionalProperty({x:{value:[2]}});

function inferredObjectCycle({left = 1, right = left + 1} = {}) {
  return left + right;
}
function inferredTupleCycle([left = 1, right = left + 1] = []) {
  return left + right;
}
function providedFirstValueCycle({left = 1, right = left + 1} = {left: 2}) {
  return left + right;
}
function inferredNestedCycle({outer: {left = 1, right = left + 1} = {}} = {}) {
  return left + right;
}
function annotatedNestedCycle({outer: {left = 1, right = left + 1} = {}}: {outer?: {left?: number; right?: number}} = {}) {
  return left + right;
}
